topic: Al-Biruni on the Concept of Pollution
questionText:

"Al-Biruni tried to explain the caste system by looking for parallels in other societies. In ancient Persia, he noted four classes: knights and princes; monks and fire-priests; lawyers, physicians, astronomers and other scientists; and peasants and artisans.
